name: writeback
description: Visually inspect React interfaces and make constrained, undoable source edits through Writeback's Tailwind-aware local bridge.

interface.longDescription: Writeback is a visual development toolkit that connects browser-based React editing with actual source code. Inspect components, resolve their source locations, make constrained styling changes, reuse Tailwind design tokens, preview diffs and safely undo modifications. Designed for frontend developers and AI coding agents.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my project's Tailwind design scale.
Resolve this React component and show its editable styles.
Change this component's padding using existing design tokens and preview the source diff.
